overall.summary: All ten blind answers (recorded before 03 and 04 were opened) match the author key. Seven items are accepted. Three need a bound revision: Q2 (A explanation wrongly says the key-based connection uses a managed identity), Q6 (stimulus fences are nested and break Markdown rendering of Q6 and Q7; key and explanations correct), and Q7 (assessed 'hard' but every distractor is eliminated by a stem constraint; reviewer estimate medium). The specifically flagged areas are otherwise resolved: the Q2 case stipulation is sufficient and no option exploits the project-versus-account identity conflict; Q3 required and null evidence is complete; the Q4 call_id explanation is correct; Q7 initial versus persistent escalation is consistent with S009 L226. Difficulty: reviewer agrees with 9 of 10 labels; with Q7 at medium the assessed counts become easy 3, medium 7, hard 0, so the set would have no hard item. The shared case is sufficient and independent for Q1 and Q2. File byte hashes for 01-04 were checked against 00-START-HERE.md and match. No live sources were consulted; all findings are against frozen evidence. Phase 1 was rerun at extra high in a fresh context that saw only 00, 01 and 02. All ten rerun answers match both the original blind answers and the key. The rerun independently found the Q6 rendering defect and agreed Q7 is not hard. Its difficulty counts were easy 6, medium 4, hard 0; it also rated Q1 and Q5 easy. Both reads agree the set has no hard item and that several items (Q1, Q5, Q7) are answerable mainly by eliminating options against explicit stem constraints.
